**I found two concrete source-level blockers in `36852b55bff25347fda3197c8f67be0a4981ab91`.** Both need correction before final acceptance. These findings come from tracing the committed code; I did not reproduce them by executing C#.

1. **Bishop milestone award query/discovery disagrees with submission.**

   `Submit` upgrades `AwardCharacterMilestone` to the trusted `ClericMilestoneGrant`. `QueryCastingCommand` and `DiscoverCastingCommands` use ordinary Player authority instead. Consequently, after genuine completed departure, the award query returns `NotAuthorized` and discovery presents an inadmissible option, while submission can commit that same award. See [ConnectedExpeditionSession.cs](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/36852b55bff25347fda3197c8f67be0a4981ab91/engine/com.decennium.foundation/Laboratory/Model/ConnectedExpeditionSession.cs#L204-L244).

   Apply consistent **command-specific host authority** across query, discovery and execution, preserving revoked-seat checks and older-profile compatibility. Add a genuine completed-departure control covering available query/discovery, successful award, duplicate protection and revoked authority. The current Bishop read probes omit award queries and companion discovery, so they miss this discrepancy.

2. **Self-hosted Guidance can bypass Dispel’s current visual-perception requirement.**

   `AuraPerceived` treats `effect.TargetId == observer` as perceived without checking blindness. The new Dispel admission relies on that predicate. An otherwise eligible Bishop with own Guidance on self and active Detect therefore passes the observation gate while Blinded; standalone Blinded does not prohibit the casting Action or end concentration. See [SharedSpellCasting.cs](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/36852b55bff25347fda3197c8f67be0a4981ab91/engine/com.decennium.foundation/Laboratory/Model/SharedSpellCasting.cs#L330-L338) and [SharedBishopDispel.cs](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/36852b55bff25347fda3197c8f67be0a4981ab91/engine/com.decennium.foundation/Laboratory/Model/SharedBishopDispel.cs#L9-L23).

   Knowing one’s own cast does not replace the required current individual observation. For the new profile, qualify self-effect observation using actual visual capability consistently across views, discovery, query and execution. Add a labeled mechanical control using the actual Blinded lifecycle, including a token obtained before sight was lost, proving denial without payment or mutation. This finding does **not** claim a genuine connected blindness producer.

I found no additional concrete blocker in the reviewed earned settlement, Invocation payment/cure/recharge, historical resource reconstruction, Aura event-time ordering, or ordinary Dispel ending paths. The retained development views substantiate the reported7/6 Invocation healing, positive fear cure, natural9 outcome changed by Aura, positive Aura healing and Dispel record.

One remaining coverage point: the genuine Invocation asserts **zero-floor vent**. Final evidence should also exercise a positive-Dissonance reduction through the paid producer; that can be a clearly labeled mechanical control.

My independent reconciliation verified:

- Both archives and all151 indexed member lengths/hashes.
- All453 compiled-input hashes,947 static-report hashes and83 historical source pins.
- Selected raw development views and six retained unchanged-state byte pairs.

I inspected source, diffs, tests and evidence scripts, with separate reviews of Invocation, Aura, Dispel and history. **I did not compile, execute C#, restore saves, run gameplay, observe workers or rerun qualification.** Development binaries differ from the frozen binaries and remain development evidence.

Any runtime correction requires a new source freeze and qualification against the corrected binaries; preserve the current run under its actual identity. Complete regression, authentic95–111 continuations, five-path evidence, final reconciliation and actual final review remain mandatory. The module remains unaccepted; no successor is authorized. Storage/Support stay held and Unity stays deferred.
